import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib

# Set up matplotlib for non-interactive backend
matplotlib.use('Agg')

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/housing_dataset.csv')

# Set styling
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
plt.rcParams['figure.facecolor'] = 'white'
plt.rcParams['axes.facecolor'] = 'white'

# === Chart 1: Price Distribution Histogram ===
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.hist(df['price'], bins=50, color='#2E86AB', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
plt.xlabel('Price', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Distribution of House Prices', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
plt.axvline(df['price'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='dashed', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {df["price"].mean():,.0f}')
plt.axvline(df['price'].median(), color='green', linestyle='dashed', linewidth=2, label=f'Median: {df["price"].median():,.0f}')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('price_distribution_histogram.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

# === Chart 2: Area vs Price Scatter Plot ===
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
scatter = plt.scatter(df['area'], df['price'], c=df['area'], cmap='viridis', alpha=0.6, s=50, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
plt.xlabel('Area (sq ft)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Price', fontsize=12)
plt.title('House Price vs Area', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, label='Area (sq ft)')
# Add trend line
z = np.polyfit(df['area'], df['price'], 1)
p = np.poly1d(z)
plt.plot(df['area'], p(df['area']), "r--", linewidth=2, label='Trend Line')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('area_vs_price_scatter.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

# === Chart 3: Average Price by Furnishing Status ===
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
furnishing_avg = df.groupby('furnishingstatus')['price'].mean().sort_values()
colors = ['#E07A5F', '#81B29A', '#F2CC8F']
bars = plt.barh(furnishing_avg.index, furnishing_avg.values, color=colors)
plt.xlabel('Average Price', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Furnishing Status', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Average House Price by Furnishing Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels on bars
for i, (idx, val) in enumerate(furnishing_avg.items()):
    plt.text(val + max(furnishing_avg.values)*0.01, i, f'${val:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('avg_price_by_furnishing.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print("All charts generated successfully!")
print(f"Total records: {len(df)}")
print(f"Price range: ${df['price'].min():,.0f} - ${df['price'].max():,.0f}")
print(f"Area range: {df['area'].min():,.0f} - {df['area'].max():,.0f} sq ft")
